target: GLIF rate of this cell in the full V1 network (1.33 Hz over 3 s)
note: Cell 82141 control, no top-down, 3 s: g_scale chosen so the rate matches the GLIF cell (1.33 Hz). gi_scale = 3 x g_scale.
visual_note: Smith et al. 2013-style grating drive (invivo/visual_drive.py), used by invivo/smith_probe.py and smith_suite.py with --ori: 180 co-tuned axons x 2 contacts (6 contacts made compound EPSPs that looked like spikelets and survived TTX), all clustered on 12 branches (sorted by preferred orientation), plus 200 untuned perisomatic GABA-A inputs locked to the grating. Tuned by hand so the soma fires ~1.5 Hz at the preferred orientation while basal dendrites carry NMDA envelopes with Na+ spikelets.
